summary.name: Thumbnail AI
summary.one_liner: A web tool that analyzes a YouTube thumbnail with AI, giving a CTR-focused rating, strengths and weaknesses, improvement tips, and generated alternatives.
use_cases: Checking a YouTube thumbnail before publishing
Getting feedback on why a thumbnail might get fewer clicks
Comparing thumbnail emotion and curiosity appeal
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a three-step flow: upload a YouTube thumbnail (title optional), receive a CTR-focused analysis covering audience fit, emotion, curiosity gap, clickbait level, and strengths and weaknesses, then generate AI-made alternative titles and thumbnail variations. The meta description adds an overall rating and improvement tips. The page text does not describe the underlying model or how the rating is computed.
notable: Accepts a single uploaded thumbnail image; title is optional
Analysis scores audience fit, emotion, curiosity gap, and clickbait level
Generates higher-CTR title alternatives and thumbnail variations
caveats: Pricing and any paid tiers are not stated on the page
Rating method and model details are not described
